name: Deliver Incremental Change
summary: Deliver a change in independently verifiable slices that preserve a working system.
description: Break and deliver a bounded implementation in vertical, behaviorally verifiable slices with explicit invariants, checkpoints, and integration evidence. Use when a change is too large for one safe edit but can progress without speculative scaffolding.
risk_reason: This skill delivers a change in independently verifiable slices that preserve a working system; it does not hide new scope inside an implementation checkpoint.
refuses: It does not build unused layers or abstractions for hypothetical future slices.
It does not defer tests, integration, migration safety, or cleanup to an undefined final phase.
It does not hide new scope inside an implementation checkpoint.

operational.latency_reason: The skill delivers a change in independently verifiable slices that preserve a working system, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
